objs.name: document
objs.description: Core artifact representing documents in P&R Management.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object representing attachments or additional information associated with a Document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Actor interacting with documents in the release and management workflows.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Grouping of Users for access control and distribution.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of Users or User Groups maintained for document distribution / acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template used when creating new documents.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal object for making changes to a Document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New document is created in the system by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: attach_information_object
evts.description: Information Object is attached to a Document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Document is reviewed for technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Change Proposals are created for a Document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Check and extend the validity period of a document.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Process to invalidate or override a document and its attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Archived or invalidated documents are reactivated.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Invalidated or overridden documents are archived.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: New version of a document is created.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribution to Distribution Lists or User Groups.
